topics.topic: Calculus (Differentiation): Limits of functions and differentiation from first principles
learningObjectives: Evaluate limits of algebraic and trigonometric functions as x approaches finite values or infinity
Differentiate standard functions (x^n, sin x, cos x) from first principles using δ-method
Establish power rule, scalar multiple rule, and sum/difference rule

topics.topic: Rules of Differentiation: Product rule, Quotient rule, and Chain rule (composite functions)
learningObjectives: Differentiate products of functions using d/dx [u(x)v(x)] = u'v + uv'
Apply the quotient rule to rational algebraic and trigonometric expressions
Use the chain rule for composite functions and fractional powers

topics.topic: Applications of Differentiation: Tangents, normals, stationary points, and curve sketching
learningObjectives: Find equations of tangents and normals to curves at specified coordinate points
Locate stationary points and classify as local maxima, minima, or points of inflexion using dy/dx and d²y/dx²
Sketch polynomial curves indicating intercepts, turning points, and asymptotes

topics.topic: Kinematics in Calculus: Rectilinear motion (displacement, velocity, and acceleration)
learningObjectives: Express velocity as time derivative of displacement: v = ds/dt
Express acceleration as time derivative of velocity: a = dv/dt = d²s/dt²
Solve mechanics word problems regarding maximum height, rest positions, and total distance travelled

topics.topic: Calculus (Integration): Indefinite integrals of polynomials and trigonometric functions
learningObjectives: Understand integration as the anti-derivative with arbitrary constant of integration C
Integrate algebraic polynomials using power rule ∫ x^n dx = (x^(n+1))/(n+1) + C
Integrate trigonometric functions: ∫ sin(ax) dx and ∫ cos(ax) dx

topics.topic: Definite Integrals and Area Under Curves
learningObjectives: Evaluate definite integrals between specified lower and upper boundary limits
Calculate area bounded by a continuous curve, the x-axis, and vertical lines x = a and x = b
Compute the area enclosed between two intersecting curves

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Calculus Proficiency Clinic
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of differentiation rules and definite integral calculations
Evaluate step-by-step mathematical rigor in kinematics problem solutions
Provide remedial drills on quotient rule and stationary point classifications

topics.topic: Coordinate Geometry of the Circle: Standard form and general equation of circles
learningObjectives: Derive standard form equation of a circle: (x - a)² + (y - b)² = r²
Convert general equation x² + y² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 to standard form by completing the square
Determine center (-g, -f) and radius r = √(g² + f² - c) and find tangent equations

topics.topic: Matrices and Determinants: 3x3 matrices, minors, cofactors, and Cramer's Rule
learningObjectives: Evaluate determinants of 3x3 matrices using cofactor expansion along rows or columns
Find matrix of minors, matrix of cofactors, and the adjoint matrix
Solve systems of three simultaneous linear equations using Cramer's Rule

topics.topic: Vectors in Three Dimensions: Components (i, j, k), dot product, and vector cross product
learningObjectives: Represent spatial vectors in component form: r = xi + yj + zk
Calculate the scalar (dot) product and determine angles between 3D vectors
Compute the vector (cross) product using 3x3 determinant expansion and find areas of parallelograms

topics.topic: Probability Distributions: Binomial distribution and Poisson distribution
learningObjectives: Derive the binomial probability formula: P(X = r) = nCr p^r q^(n-r)
Calculate mean (μ = np) and variance (σ² = npq) for binomial trials
Introduce the Poisson distribution P(X = x) = (λ^x * e^-λ) / x! for rare random events

topics.topic: Comprehensive Further Mathematics Termly Revision & WAEC Problem Seminar
learningObjectives: Integrate calculus, 3x3 matrices, 3D vectors, and probability distributions
Solve past WASSCE and NECO Further Mathematics Paper 2 questions under timed conditions
Refine analytical accuracy and presentation of mathematical proofs

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Broadsheet Score Recording
learningObjectives: Examine cumulative SSS 2 Further Mathematics syllabus coverage
Score scripts in accordance with national examination Council marking keys
Compile broadsheet assessment records for school administrative archives
